title: EquivalenceCertificate
description: v0.2 (additive: `scope`). Written next to each converted program in a delivery pull request (programs/<PROGRAM>/certificate.json). It pins the legacy source and the verifier so CI can re-run the proof independently on fresh inputs.

path.description: COBOL source path in the legacy repository

items.description: Copybook paths in the legacy repository

modules.description: Paths of CALLed programs compiled with it

verification.description: Diocle's held-out certification. CI repeats it with its own seed.

commit.description: Diocle commit whose services/verifier produced the result

scope.description: Additive. What this certificate does and does not rest on, so a reader of the file alone can tell a skipped check from a passed one.

oracle.description: What the Java was compared with, in one sentence (GnuCOBOL, or the mainframe's captured output).

standIns.description: Stated stand-ins the result depends on (SQLite for DB2, Berkeley DB for VSAM, Diocle's CEE3ABD routine). Empty when none.

status.description: not-run is not a pass: the breaker was off, or the program's shape is not one it can attack.

reason.description: Why it did not run, when the run recorded one.

crossCheck.description: skipped: it was asked for and could not run. no-valid-inputs: the model proposed nothing that fitted the layout. Only ran tried anything.

guardReview.description: The optional model review, with the verdicts of run.schema.json. flag: it completed with findings. skipped: it was configured but did not complete (a cap or an error). The deterministic policy runs regardless.
